meta.title: Void Clash – 1
meta.description: No matter how grand the star or how insignificant the dust speck, they both meet the same fate in the end.

units.rawText: <color=red>Warning, port thrusters damaged.</color>
units.displayText: Warning, port thrusters damaged.

spans.text: Warning, port thrusters damaged.

units.rawText: <color=red>Warning, starboard attitude control nozzles damaged.</color>
units.displayText: Warning, starboard attitude control nozzles damaged.

spans.text: Warning, starboard attitude control nozzles damaged.

units.rawText: <color=red>Warning, operand defensive barrier at 40% damage.</color>
units.displayText: Warning, operand defensive barrier at 40% damage.

spans.text: Warning, operand defensive barrier at 40% damage.

units.rawText: An endless stream of warning windows fills the control interface.
units.displayText: An endless stream of warning windows fills the control interface.

spans.text: An endless stream of warning windows fills the control interface.

units.rawText: Dammit, they just won't quit...
units.displayText: Dammit, they just won't quit...

spans.text: Dammit, they just won't quit...

units.rawText: An endless stream of entropics jump onto the spaceship one after another.
units.displayText: An endless stream of entropics jump onto the spaceship one after another.

spans.text: An endless stream of entropics jump onto the spaceship one after another.

units.rawText: Xinghuan latches her exo's feet onto the hull of the vessel and her beam saber cuts blazing arcs through the ranks of the enemy.
units.displayText: Xinghuan latches her exo's feet onto the hull of the vessel and her beam saber cuts blazing arcs through the ranks of the enemy.

spans.text: Xinghuan latches her exo's feet onto the hull of the vessel and her beam saber cuts blazing arcs through the ranks of the enemy.

units.rawText: Hss—
units.displayText: Hss—

spans.text: Hss—

units.rawText: Ngh... The right thruster's also...
units.displayText: Ngh... The right thruster's also...

spans.text: Ngh... The right thruster's also...

units.rawText: Not good... the ship can't maintain its velocity!
units.displayText: Not good... the ship can't maintain its velocity!

spans.text: Not good... the ship can't maintain its velocity!

units.rawText: Get in the escape pod, you two! I'll grab you with the exo... Uwah!
units.displayText: Get in the escape pod, you two! I'll grab you with the exo... Uwah!

spans.text: Get in the escape pod, you two! I'll grab you with the exo... Uwah!

units.rawText: A set of sharp-tipped tentacles leave terrifying scars on the exo's structure.
units.displayText: A set of sharp-tipped tentacles leave terrifying scars on the exo's structure.

spans.text: A set of sharp-tipped tentacles leave terrifying scars on the exo's structure.

units.rawText: (Or not... Even if I could grab them and run, the exo can't move fast enough to get away...)
units.displayText: Or not... Even if I could grab them and run, the exo can't move fast enough to get away...

spans.text: Or not... Even if I could grab them and run, the exo can't move fast enough to get away...

units.rawText: (What should I do... What should I do... What should I do?! Isn't there a way to get Hubble and the others away...)
units.displayText: What should I do... What should I do... What should I do?! Isn't there a way to get Hubble and the others away...

spans.text: What should I do... What should I do... What should I do?! Isn't there a way to get Hubble and the others away...

units.rawText: Xinghuan looks around, and the purple entropic hordes have them completely surrounded.
units.displayText: Xinghuan looks around, and the purple entropic hordes have them completely surrounded.

spans.text: Xinghuan looks around, and the purple entropic hordes have them completely surrounded.

units.rawText: A streak of eerie dark purple shoots out from a distant comet, heading right for her.
units.displayText: A streak of eerie dark purple shoots out from a distant comet, heading right for her.

spans.text: A streak of eerie dark purple shoots out from a distant comet, heading right for her.

units.rawText: <size=40>Xinghuan, look out!</size>
units.displayText: Xinghuan, look out!

spans.text: Xinghuan, look out!

units.rawText: An entropizing shell flies in from a blind spot, on course to hit Xinghuan in the head. She's about to dodge when she remembers that the spaceship's cockpit is directly behind her, and the ship is going to have a much harder time evading than she does.
units.displayText: An entropizing shell flies in from a blind spot, on course to hit Xinghuan in the head. She's about to dodge when she remembers that the spaceship's cockpit is directly behind her, and the ship is going to have a much harder time evading than she does.

spans.text: An entropizing shell flies in from a blind spot, on course to hit Xinghuan in the head. She's about to dodge when she remembers that the spaceship's cockpit is directly behind her, and the ship is going to have a much harder time evading than she does.

units.rawText: (This is bad, if I dodge now, Hubble and the others will...)
units.displayText: This is bad, if I dodge now, Hubble and the others will...

spans.text: This is bad, if I dodge now, Hubble and the others will...

units.rawText: (Kaboom!!!)
units.displayText: (Kaboom!!!)

spans.text: (Kaboom!!!)

units.rawText: A beam from afar pierces the shell, which instantly explodes. The shockwave buffets the exo and rattles the piloting cradle.
units.displayText: A beam from afar pierces the shell, which instantly explodes. The shockwave buffets the exo and rattles the piloting cradle.

spans.text: A beam from afar pierces the shell, which instantly explodes. The shockwave buffets the exo and rattles the piloting cradle.

units.rawText: Urgh... Was that covering fire?! But who...
units.displayText: Urgh... Was that covering fire?! But who...

spans.text: Urgh... Was that covering fire?! But who...

units.rawText: Xinghuan reflexively activates the exo's infrared target designator and switches her terminal to wide-area broadcast comms.
units.displayText: Xinghuan reflexively activates the exo's infrared target designator and switches her terminal to wide-area broadcast comms.

spans.text: Xinghuan reflexively activates the exo's infrared target designator and switches her terminal to wide-area broadcast comms.

units.rawText: Enemy position locked!
units.displayText: Enemy position locked!

spans.text: Enemy position locked!

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: A barrage of beams fires from the direction of Saturn, each one striking the enemies marked by Xinghuan's designator.
units.displayText: A barrage of beams fires from the direction of Saturn, each one striking the enemies marked by Xinghuan's designator.

spans.text: A barrage of beams fires from the direction of Saturn, each one striking the enemies marked by Xinghuan's designator.

units.rawText: Amidst the explosions that follow, a video link request suddenly pops up on her terminal. After Xinghuan accepts, a familiar green-haired form appears on the monitor.
units.displayText: Amidst the explosions that follow, a video link request suddenly pops up on her terminal. After Xinghuan accepts, a familiar green-haired form appears on the monitor.

spans.text: Amidst the explosions that follow, a video link request suddenly pops up on her terminal. After Xinghuan accepts, a familiar green-haired form appears on the monitor.

units.rawText: I knew you'd be okay, Xinghuan.
units.displayText: I knew you'd be okay, Xinghuan.

spans.text: I knew you'd be okay, Xinghuan.

units.rawText: Beepbeep!
units.displayText: Beepbeep!

spans.text: Beepbeep!

units.rawText: Yuwang, Liuxing! Whew, I'm so glad to see you two again...
units.displayText: Yuwang, Liuxing! Whew, I'm so glad to see you two again...

spans.text: Yuwang, Liuxing! Whew, I'm so glad to see you two again...

units.rawText: Haha, well, I'm an ace taikonaut, after all; how could I die in a place like that? Although, it would be nice if you IDed yourself before the cover fire.
units.displayText: Haha, well, I'm an ace taikonaut, after all; how could I die in a place like that? Although, it would be nice if you IDed yourself before the cover fire.

spans.text: Haha, well, I'm an ace taikonaut, after all; how could I die in a place like that? Although, it would be nice if you IDed yourself
before
the cover fire.

units.rawText: I don't think anyone else would have understood what you were trying to do.
units.displayText: I don't think anyone else would have understood what you were trying to do.

spans.text: I don't think anyone else would have understood what you were trying to do.

units.rawText: I should be the one saying that— You need to at least talk about your battle plan before actually executing it. And you still owe me lunch.
units.displayText: I should be the one saying that— You need to at least talk about your battle plan before actually executing it. And you still owe me lunch.

spans.text: I should be the one saying that— You need to at least talk about your battle plan before actually executing it. And you still owe me lunch.

units.rawText: Aw...
units.displayText: Aw...

spans.text: Aw...

units.rawText: Beepbeep...
units.displayText: Beepbeep...

spans.text: Beepbeep...

units.rawText: You don't need to cover for her, Liuxing. In any case, we'll chat later. Right now, we'll take care of the enemies.
units.displayText: You don't need to cover for her, Liuxing. In any case, we'll chat later. Right now, we'll take care of the enemies.

spans.text: You don't need to cover for her, Liuxing. In any case, we'll chat later. Right now, we'll take care of the enemies.

units.rawText: Team 08, cover the exo. All other teams, deploy and wipe out the nearby entropics.
units.displayText: Team 08, cover the exo. All other teams, deploy and wipe out the nearby entropics.

spans.text: Team 08, cover the exo. All other teams, deploy and wipe out the nearby entropics.

units.rawText: The exos scatter like shooting stars, spreading out to cleanse the surroundings of the purple spots infesting them.
units.displayText: The exos scatter like shooting stars, spreading out to cleanse the surroundings of the purple spots infesting them.

spans.text: The exos scatter like shooting stars, spreading out to cleanse the surroundings of the purple spots infesting them.

units.rawText: Yuwang! Remember to dispatch a squad to protect the spaceship.
units.displayText: Yuwang! Remember to dispatch a squad to protect the spaceship.

spans.text: Yuwang! Remember to dispatch a squad to protect the spaceship.

units.rawText: I was just about to ask; where did you get that spaceship from? Weren't you supposed to be in an escape pod?
units.displayText: I was just about to ask; where did you get that spaceship from? Weren't you supposed to be in an escape pod?

spans.text: I was just about to ask; where did you get that spaceship from? Weren't you supposed to be in an escape pod?

units.rawText: Haha, you could call it a fated encounter. Just wait and you'll find out!
units.displayText: Haha, you could call it a fated encounter. Just wait and you'll find out!

spans.text: Haha, you could call it a fated encounter. Just wait and you'll find out!

units.rawText: With a "beep", Hubble's image appears on the comm channel.
units.displayText: With a "beep", Hubble's image appears on the comm channel.

spans.text: With a "beep", Hubble's image appears on the comm channel.

units.rawText: Hehe, it's been a while, Yuwang.
units.displayText: Hehe, it's been a while, Yuwang.

spans.text: Hehe, it's been a while, Yuwang.

units.rawText: Hubble?! Why are you with Xinghuan? No, wait... Why are you even in Jiutian Sector?
units.displayText: Hubble?! Why are you with Xinghuan? No, wait... Why are you even in Jiutian Sector?

spans.text: Hubble?! Why are you with Xinghuan? No, wait... Why are you even in Jiutian Sector?

units.rawText: At first, we came to Jiutian Sector to find you, but along the way we rescued Xinghuan from trouble near Oberon.
units.displayText: At first, we came to Jiutian Sector to find you, but along the way we rescued Xinghuan from trouble near Oberon.

spans.text: At first, we came to Jiutian Sector to find you, but along the way we rescued Xinghuan from trouble near Oberon.

units.rawText: Oberon, you say... That region's been heavily entropized and all the agents manning the posts there have already evacuated.
units.displayText: Oberon, you say... That region's been heavily entropized and all the agents manning the posts there have already evacuated.

spans.text: Oberon, you say... That region's been heavily entropized and all the agents manning the posts there have already evacuated.

units.rawText: Yes, although we managed to see something incredible thanks to the surveillance gear in an abandoned base.
units.displayText: Yes, although we managed to see something incredible thanks to the surveillance gear in an abandoned base.

spans.text: Yes, although we managed to see something incredible thanks to the surveillance gear in an abandoned base.

units.rawText: You mean these comets?
units.displayText: You mean these comets?

spans.text: You mean these comets?

units.rawText: Far more than these. These are just the tip of the iceberg... I'll sync the data and images to you.
units.displayText: Far more than these. These are just the tip of the iceberg... I'll sync the data and images to you.

spans.text: Far more than these. These are just the tip of the iceberg... I'll sync the data and images to you.

units.rawText: ...That many?!
units.displayText: ...That many?!

spans.text: ...That many?!

units.rawText: An endless array of entropized comets comes into view at the edge of the Solar System. Yuwang can't help but tighten his grip on the terminal he's holding.
units.displayText: An endless array of entropized comets comes into view at the edge of the Solar System. Yuwang can't help but tighten his grip on the terminal he's holding.

spans.text: An endless array of entropized comets comes into view at the edge of the Solar System. Yuwang can't help but tighten his grip on the terminal he's holding.

units.rawText: Looks like the entropized comet that made Titan-fall was only the beginning... We need to inform the Ringworld ASAP.
units.displayText: Looks like the entropized comet that made Titan-fall was only the beginning... We need to inform the Ringworld ASAP.

spans.text: Looks like the entropized comet that made Titan-fall was only the beginning... We need to inform the Ringworld ASAP.

units.rawText: ...System command, hail Xuannu and sync this info to her.
units.displayText: ...System command, hail Xuannu and sync this info to her.

spans.text: ...System command, hail Xuannu and sync this info to her.

units.rawText: All fighters, listen up; weapons free, prioritize operands for weapons systems.
units.displayText: All fighters, listen up; weapons free, prioritize operands for weapons systems.

spans.text: All fighters, listen up; weapons free, prioritize operands for weapons systems.

units.rawText: Eliminate the pursuing comets and entropics within 10 minutes, we need to return to the Ringworld base ASAP...
units.displayText: Eliminate the pursuing comets and entropics within 10 minutes, we need to return to the Ringworld base ASAP...

spans.text: Eliminate the pursuing comets and entropics within 10 minutes, we need to return to the Ringworld base ASAP...
